etymology: Phono-semantic: hand (扌) + 員 (phonetic ソン) — taken away by hand: to diminish, damage; the diminished side: a loss.
mnemonic: A hand skims off the top and the total drops — ソン. 損する: coming out lighter than you went in.

etymology: Phono-semantic (simplified from 團): enclosure (囗) + a phonetic — people rolled into one round body: a group, a troupe.
mnemonic: Everyone squeezed into one circle — ダン. 布団 rolls bedding the same way; 団体 rolls people.

etymology: Compound (simplified from 斷): the axe (斤) chopping through bound threads — to cut off: to sever, to refuse, to judge decisively.
mnemonic: One axe-fall through the whole tangle — ことわる. 断る declines; 判断 cuts the question in two and picks.

etymology: Phono-semantic: 筑 (phonetic チク) + wood (木) — earth rammed between wooden forms: to construct, build.
mnemonic: Frame, fill, tamp, repeat: walls rise — きずく. 建築: the tamping, professionalized.

etymology: Phono-semantic: money (貝) + 宁 'stowed' (phonetic チョ) — treasure put by under the roof: to store, save.
mnemonic: Shells stacked in the cupboard for winter — チョ. 貯金: the cupboard at the bank.

etymology: Phono-semantic: bow (弓) + 長 'long' (phonetic チョウ) — the bowstring drawn long: to stretch, extend; taut effort (頑張る).
mnemonic: Pull the string until the bow groans — はる. 頑張って: stay drawn, don't loose yet.

etymology: Phono-semantic: person (亻) + 亭 'roadside pavilion' (phonetic テイ) — the traveler stopped at the rest-house: to halt.
mnemonic: Pull over at the little pavilion — テイ. バス停: the pavilion, reduced to a pole and a sign.

etymology: Phono-semantic: grain (禾) + 呈 (phonetic テイ) — the measured-out portion: extent, degree, the 'about how much'.
mnemonic: How far up the measuring pole the grain reaches — ほど. これほど, 程度: quantity with manners.

etymology: Phono-semantic: movement (辶) + 啇 (phonetic テキ) — going exactly where one should: fitting, suitable.
mnemonic: The key that walks to its own lock — テキ. 適当 can mean 'perfectly apt' or 'whatever works' — Japanese shrugs.

etymology: Compound: road (道) + hand (寸) — a hand on your shoulder along the way: to guide, lead.
mnemonic: Someone who knows the road, walking you down it — みちびく. 指導: the hand that corrects your grip.

etymology: Phono-semantic: metal (金) + 同 (phonetic ドウ) — the everyday red metal: copper.
mnemonic: The metal that's the 'same' everywhere: pipes, coins, wire — ドウ. 銅メダル: third place, honest metal.

etymology: Compound ideograph: walking (彳) and picking up a cowrie (貝→旦) with the hand (寸) — finding value on the road: to gain, to be able.
mnemonic: Money found mid-stride — える. 得する: the walk that pays for itself; 納得: when understanding is the coin.

etymology: Compound: lush growth over 毋 'do not' — the plant you must not touch: poison.
mnemonic: The prettiest plant in the garden, fenced off — ドク. 毒: nature's 'do not' sign.

etymology: Phono-semantic (simplified from 獨): dog (犭) + a phonetic — the dog that hunts alone: solitary, single; also 'German' (独逸).
mnemonic: One dog, one bug, no company — ひとり. 独身: single, as a lifestyle; 独学: alone, as a school.

etymology: Phono-semantic: person (亻) + 壬 'carrying-pole' (phonetic ニン) — the load laid on someone's shoulders: duty, appointment.
mnemonic: The pole settles onto your shoulders: it's yours now — まかせる. 責任: the pole with your name burned in.

etymology: Phono-semantic: fire (火) + 然 (phonetic ネン — which originally meant 'to burn' before being borrowed for 'thus') — fire reclaiming its old word: to burn.
mnemonic: 然 lost its flames to grammar, so it came back with a torch — もえる. 燃えるゴミ: Tuesday's burnable truth.

etymology: Pictograph: originally a bear — an animal of legendary strength and skill; borrowed for 'to be able': ability.
mnemonic: Strong as a bear, and clever with it — ノウ. 可能, 能力: the bear inside your skill set; 能 theater borrowed its gravitas.

etymology: Phono-semantic: stone (石) + 皮 (phonetic ハ) — stone tearing through hide: to rip, break, defeat.
mnemonic: Rock meets leather; leather loses — やぶる. 破れる: the sound this kanji makes.

etymology: Phono-semantic: 半 'half' (phonetic ハン) + blade (刂) — cutting a matter cleanly in two: to judge; the seal that ratifies it.
mnemonic: The verdict splits the case down the middle — ハン. 裁判: professionals with very steady knives.

etymology: Phono-semantic: split wood (片) + 反 (phonetic ハン) — the carved plank pressed and flipped: a printing block, an edition.
mnemonic: Carve once, print a thousand — ハン. 出版: the plank that became an industry.

etymology: Phono-semantic: beast (犭) + 㔾 (phonetic ハン) — the animal impulse breaking bounds: to violate, commit.
mnemonic: The leash snaps and the line is crossed — おかす. 犯人: whoever's holding the empty leash.

etymology: Pictograph: two people standing in a row, matched against each other — to compare; a ratio.
mnemonic: Stand them back to back and measure — くらべる. 比べる: humanity's oldest chart.

etymology: Phono-semantic: 弗 (phonetic ヒ) + money (貝) — money flowing out through the strainer: expense, cost.
mnemonic: 貝 with 弗 on top — practically the dollar sign bleeding shells — ヒ. 交通費, 生活費: the strainers of a paycheck.

etymology: Pictograph: a bird's wings spread in opposite directions — divergence: not, contrary to, wrong.
mnemonic: Wings that agree on nothing — ヒ. Prefix of the opposite: 非常, 非公開; inside 悲, it tears the heart.

etymology: Compound: a person (亻) with the quiver stocked at their side — arrows ready before the need: to equip, prepare.
mnemonic: Full quiver before the hunt — そなえる. 準備 checks the arrows; 設備 bolts them to the wall.

etymology: Phono-semantic: words (言) + 平 'level' (phonetic ヒョウ) — weighing something in words until the scale sits level: to evaluate.
mnemonic: Verbal scales: praise on one pan, faults on the other — ヒョウ. 評判: where the needle settled publicly.

etymology: Compound ideograph: money (貝) divided (分) too many ways — wealth split until none remains: poor.
mnemonic: One shell, eight heirs — まずしい. 貧乏: arithmetic as tragedy.

etymology: Compound ideograph: woman (女) + broom (帚) — the married woman who keeps the house: lady, wife.
mnemonic: The broom is hers, and so is the household — フ. 夫婦: pole-carrier and broom-holder, incorporated.

etymology: Phono-semantic: hand + cloth (巾) — woven cloth held out: linen; what cloth does when shaken open: to spread.
mnemonic: Unfurl the bolt across the counter — ぬの. 布団 spreads it on the floor; 財布 folds it around money.

etymology: Compound ideograph: halberd (戈) + foot (止) — marching under arms; the classical gloss 'stopping spears' reads it as strength that ends fighting: military.
mnemonic: Armed and advancing — or armed so no one else does — ブ. 武士: the kanji with a sword through its walk.

etymology: Phono-semantic: step (彳) + 复 'go back over' (phonetic フク) — walking the same road again: to return, restore, repeat.
mnemonic: Retrace the route until it's yours — フク. 復習 re-walks the lesson; 回復 re-walks you back to health.

etymology: Phono-semantic: garment (衤) + 复 (phonetic フク) — clothing lined double: duplicated, compound.
mnemonic: The coat with a second coat sewn inside — フク. 複雑: layers past counting.

etymology: Simplified from 佛: person (亻) + a phonetic — the Awakened One rendered human-side-first: Buddha; also France (仏蘭西).
mnemonic: A person turned slightly inward — ほとけ. 仏教 walks that turn; 大仏 casts it in bronze.

etymology: Compound ideograph: rice (米) divided fine (分) — grain ground to dust: flour, powder.
mnemonic: Rice split until it's weather — こな. 小麦粉: wheat that met this kanji.

etymology: Phono-semantic: thread (糸) + 扁 'flat tablets' (phonetic ヘン) — bamboo slips laced into a book: to compile; the same lacing in wool: to knit.
mnemonic: Pages stitched in order, stitches paged in order — あむ. 編集: knitting other people's words.

etymology: Compound ideograph: a person (亻) carrying an infant (呆) — holding safe: to protect, keep, guarantee.
mnemonic: Carried the way you carry a newborn — たもつ. 保険 charges monthly for those arms.

etymology: Compound: a sentenced man (幸, the manacles) brought to account — requital delivered: to repay; the news of it: report.
mnemonic: The verdict comes back to its sender — ホウ. 情報 is the flow; 報告 the memo; 報い the karma.

etymology: Pictograph: the ritual vessel (豆) heaped over the brim — abundance offered: bountiful.
mnemonic: The altar bowl stacked past sense — ゆたか. 豊か: the harvest photographed for the brochure.

etymology: Compound: grain flung out in both hands to dry under the fierce sun — exposure; fierce as that sun: violent, sudden.
mnemonic: Everything hurled out at once under a punishing sky — あばれる. 暴力, 暴走: the kanji off its leash.

etymology: Phono-semantic: 卯 (phonetic ボウ) + money (貝) — goods exchanged across thresholds: trade.
mnemonic: Shells passing through the open hatch, both directions — ボウ. 貿易: the hatch scaled to harbors.

etymology: Phono-semantic: mound (阝) + 方 (phonetic ボウ) — the embankment raised against the flood: to defend, prevent.
mnemonic: The levee facing the right direction before the rain — ふせぐ. 予防: the levee built early; 消防 the one that runs.

etymology: Phono-semantic: 敄 (phonetic ム) + strength (力) — effort pressed into service: duties, business.
mnemonic: Spear, stick and muscle: whatever the office demands — つとめる. 事務: the same kanji at a desk.

etymology: Compound: eyes veiled (罒+冖) in the deep of evening (夕) under a tangle of growth — what the closed eye sees: a dream.
mnemonic: Grass, veil, dusk — and behind the lids, a whole cinema — ゆめ. 夢を見る: 'to see a dream', never merely have one.

etymology: Phono-semantic: movement (辶) + 米 (phonetic メイ) — paths crossing like the strokes of 米: to lose the way, to waver.
mnemonic: Six paths radiate from one point; you take the seventh — まよう. 迷惑: your wandering, billed to others.

etymology: Compound ideograph: thread (糸) + white cloth (帛) — fiber spun into soft white cloth: cotton.
mnemonic: White fluff queued to become thread — わた. 綿100%: the tag's favorite kanji.

etymology: Phono-semantic: cart (車) + 兪 (phonetic ユ) — goods carried over: to transport, ship.
mnemonic: Cart to boat, boat to cart, cargo unbothered — ユ. 輸入 and 輸出: this kanji at both ends of the sea.

etymology: Pictograph read as a roofed storehouse on posts — what stays in storage after needs are met: surplus, remainder.
mnemonic: The shed still half full after winter — あまる. 余裕: surplus as a personality trait.
